Title: Microsoft Cognitive Services | QnA Maker API

Body.Content:
QnA Maker API provides a web-based service to train AI to respond to questions in a natural, conversational way. Its graphical user interface simplifies training and managing your models. This evolution represents a major milestone in terms of maturity, SLA, and capabilities.
